# Play — Room with a View

- SudokuPad: [Room with a View on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Room with a View on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Every rule is native: the four windows are f-puzzles `extraregion`s (also shaded with a pale cell colour), and the clues
are `skyscraper`s. I have not opened the links in a browser. If anything looks off, use `grid.svg` in this folder as the
reference picture.

Windows (extra regions): r2-4 c2-4, r2-4 c6-8, r6-8 c2-4, r6-8 c6-8.

Skyscraper clues (position = count; r0 = above, r10 = below, c0 = left, c10 = right): r0c3 = 7; r0c6 = 5; r0c7 = 3; r1c10 = 2; r4c10 = 2; r10c2 = 5; r10c4 = 7; r10c7 = 7; r10c8 = 4; r6c0 = 2.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
